name: Shipathon S4
tagline: Classify WhatsApp chats into movie-character personas.
description: Word2Vec embeddings over context-based dialogues, classified with a centroid model into six movie-character behaviour types.
about: Problem Statement 3 — movie character predictor using WhatsApp chat. Used Word2Vec to create a vector space of context-based dialogues to classify jargon into six movie characters representing different behaviours. Recreated centroid classifier using Euclidean distances to classify chats by the movie character they most resemble.
